title: AgriCredit Hub
tagline: Smallholder farmers in Kenya can’t get affordable loans without land titles
whyNow: Food security concerns are rising as climate pressures tighten yields, and new agri‑tech funding streams are emerging, making it urgent to bridge the credit gap for Kenya’s 4 million smallholders now.

marketGap: There is no digital platform that offers collateral‑free, data‑driven micro‑loans to Kenyan smallholders, leaving them dependent on informal lenders at exorbitant rates.
executionPlan: Build a mobile MVP that connects farmers to partner micro‑finance institutions, using alternative credit data (satellite‑derived weather, soil test results, sales history) to assess risk. Pilot the app in two counties with 1,000 farmers, charging a modest interest‑rate share on each loan. Scale by adding more lenders and integrating input‑purchase bundles.
